cards.direction_or_boundary: Group medians and individual samples span large ratios that survive whole-group and uncertainty filters.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Group medians with geometric-mean, uncertainty-filter, and leave-one-group alternatives.
cards.object: Thirty depth intervals nested in five ice-sample collection groups.
cards.one_liner: Particle abundance is highly heterogeneous across samples and collection groups.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: A new horizon sampled within each group should retain between-group heterogeneity above fivefold; failure is convergence to a common group distribution.

cards.scope: Observed concentration heterogeneity only; it does not establish transport causality.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The source reports strongly variable concentrations across cores and horizons, including a 33–75,143 per-liter range.
target_alignment.paper_location: Results on whole-core and horizon-level concentration variability.

cards.direction_or_boundary: PE or varnish is the largest listed component in most samples and their combined median share is high.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Sample-level dominant-class and combined-share summaries with group-equal and whole-group holdouts.
cards.object: Per-sample polymer percentage compositions across all 30 intervals.
cards.one_liner: Two polymer classes dominate most observed compositions, while their combined share remains group-dependent.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: A blinded additional horizon set should retain a majority dominated by the same two broad classes; failure is dominance in fewer than half the samples.

cards.scope: Composition percentages share the same samples as total abundance and are not independent replication.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The source reports variable polymer mixtures with PE and varnish prominent in multiple cores and horizons.
target_alignment.paper_location: Results on polymer composition across cores and horizons.

interpretation: These two cards are verified reference discoveries for blind-rediscovery diagnostics and are not an exhaustive answer set.
